.directory-search-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:10px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.directory-field{min-width:0}.directory-field label{display:block;color:#e6f5ff;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;margin:0 0 6px 3px}
.directory-field .searchbox{min-height:46px}.directory-field .searchbox input{min-width:0}
.hero-search>p{font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:650px){.directory-search-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:9px}.directory-field label{font-size:10px}.directory-field .searchbox button{padding:0 10px}}

/* Recherche unique — encadrement institutionnel */
.directory-search-single{width:min(100%,850px);margin:18px auto 0;text-align:left;position:relative;z-index:2}
.directory-search-single>label{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;margin:0 0 9px 5px}
.directory-search-single .professional-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:68px;padding:8px 9px 8px 17px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78);border-radius:15px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,20,55,.25),0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.12);transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.directory-search-single .professional-search:focus-within{border-color:#f2c94c;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,20,55,.25),0 0 0 5px rgba(242,201,76,.24)}
.directory-search-single .search-symbol{font-size:29px;line-height:1;color:#176b9e;flex:0 0 auto}
.directory-search-single .professional-search input{min-width:0;flex:1;border:0!important;outline:0!important;background:transparent!important;color:#132237!important;font-size:16px!important;padding:12px 7px!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.directory-search-single .professional-search input::placeholder{color:#8392a3;opacity:1}
.directory-search-single .professional-search .mic{flex:0 0 43px;width:43px;height:43px;border:1px solid #d6e4ef;border-radius:10px;background:#edf6fc;color:#075d94;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}
.directory-search-single .professional-search .search-btn{min-height:48px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:10px;background:#0a5f98;color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #06416a30}
.directory-search-single .professional-search .search-btn:hover{background:#074a78}
.directory-search-single>small{display:block;margin:9px 5px 0;color:#e1f1fb;font-size:11px}

}

 .search-results-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 13px;margin:8px 0;background:#edf7fd;border:1px solid #c8e0ee;border-radius:8px;color:#075d94;font-size:13px}.search-result-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,430px),1fr));gap:12px;margin:10px 0 18px}.search-result-list .agent{margin:0;min-width:0}.search-result-list .profile{height:100%}body.dark .search-results-heading{background:#163448;border-color:#31556e;color:#ccecff}</style>
<style id="igt-auth-styles">
#igt-auth-gate[hidden]{display:none!important}
#igt-auth-gate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999999;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#071b35,#123d60);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}#igt-auth-card{width:min(430px,100%);background:#fff;color:#172334;border-radius:18px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #0006}#igt-auth-card h2{margin:0 0 8px;color:#123d60}#igt-auth-card p{color:#5b6572;line-height:1.5}#igt-auth-card label{display:block;font-weight:600;margin:14px 0 6px}#igt-auth-card input{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:13px;border:1px solid #ccd4df;border-radius:9px;font-size:16px}#igt-auth-confirm-wrap[hidden]{display:none!important}#igt-auth-submit{width:100%;margin-top:20px;padding:13px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:#0d4772;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:16px}#igt-auth-message{margin-top:12px;font-size:14px;min-height:20px;color:#a32626}#igt-auth-user{position:relative;right:auto;bottom:auto;z-index:20;background:#f1f7fc;color:#123d60;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid #d6e5f0;border-radius:12px;font:13px Arial;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0b5cad12;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;max-width:min(420px,60vw)}#igt-auth-user button{margin-left:4px;border:1px solid #c6d9e8;background:white;color:#123d60;border-radius:7px;padding:6px 8px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700} @media(max-width:600px){#igt-auth-user{max-width:100%;font-size:11px;flex-wrap:wrap} .top{height:auto;min-height:68px;padding:9px 12px}.topright{gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}}body.igt-auth-pending{overflow:hidden}
</style>
<style id="igt-portal-modern">.topright{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;min-width:0;gap:10px}.topright #igt-auth-user{margin-left:auto}.portal-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.portal-header>div:last-child{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.portal-header small{color:#718096;font-size:11px}#igt-message-targets option{padding:7px}#igt-message-targets:focus{outline:2px solid #75bde8;outline-offset:1px}@media(max-width:600px){.topright{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start}.top{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.topright #igt-auth-user{max-width:100%;width:100%}}</style>

<style id="igt-corrections-nov-2026">
/* Recherche : intitulé demandé, centré et lisible */
.igt-search-heading{text-align:center!important;max-width:900px;margin:0 auto 14px!important;padding:0 12px}
.igt-search-heading h2{font-size:clamp(19px,3.2vw,27px)!important;line-height:1.3!important;font-weight:900!important;color:#0b355c!important;margin:0 auto 8px!important}
.igt-search-heading p{font-size:clamp(14px,2vw,17px)!important;line-height:1.5!important;text-align:center!important;margin:0 auto!important;color:#526579!important}
/* Retirer les petits titres/badges placés en haut des diapositives. */
.hero-copy>.badge{display:none!important}
/* Date et heure : plus grandes et en gras. */
.igt-live-clock{font-size:13px!important;font-weight:800!important}
.igt-live-clock #igt-date{font-size:14px!important;font-weight:900!important}
.igt-live-clock strong{font-size:21px!important;font-weight:900!important}
.igt-presence,.igt-location{font-weight:700!important}
@media(max-width:700px){
 .igt-live-clock{font-size:11px!important}
 .igt-live-clock #igt-date{font-size:12px!important}
 .igt-live-clock strong{font-size:17px!important}
}
/* Pied de page institutionnel : bleu et textes blancs. */
.igt-footer,.igt-footer .footer-inner,.igt-footer .footer-inner h2,.igt-footer .footer-inner h3,
.igt-footer .footer-inner p,.igt-footer .footer-inner a,.igt-footer .footer-links a,
.igt-footer .igt-identity-line,.igt-footer .footer-bottom,.igt-footer .footer-bottom strong{
 background-color:transparent;
 color:#fff!important;
}
.igt-footer{background:#1d4787!important;color:#fff!important}
.igt-footer .footer-bottom{background:#123d70!important;color:#fff!important}
.igt-footer a{text-decoration:underline!important;text-underline-offset:3px}
</style>
